operational_threshold_note: Raised from notebook F1-optimal 0.000673 to 0.5 for operational use. The notebook value was optimal on training data where classes were nearly perfectly separated (CV AUC=0.9998); it treated any p_fault above 0.001 as an alert, which meant continuous false alarms on real telemetry. 0.5 is the natural probability decision boundary.
notes: Trained on ALFA per-window features; retrain on real fleet data before production.
